messages.subject: Dunn-smyth or CUSUM residual plots
parts:
Hi all,

Is there a function or R package to produce diagnostic residual plots for single season occupancy models in the unmarked format without needing to use RPresence?   Either Dunn-smyth from Warton et al 2017 https://doi.org/10.1111/2041-210X.12761, or CUSUM.

Thank you!

Janine
